invariants.rationale: The method always returns a (possibly empty) List, never null, due to new ArrayList<>();
partitionPath is passed in as a parameter and is required for file lookup; it is not explicitly checked for null, but is assumed to be non-null for file lookup operations.
All elements added to result (smallFileLocations) are newly created SmallFile objects, so none are null.
Files added to result have size strictly less than the configured small file limit.
Every SmallFile in the result is by construction from the given partitionPath context, which must be non-null for file operations.
